delivery_target: Future callers that do not have is_untyped_cap in context can use this weaker form
new_lemma:
lemma descendants_range_imply_no_descendants_no_untyped:
    "\<lbrakk>descendants_range cap p s; descendants_inc (cdt s) (caps_of_state s);
    caps_of_state s p = Some cap; valid_objs s; valid_mdb s\<rbrakk>
    \<Longrightarrow> descendants_of p (cdt s) = {}"
    apply (simp add:descendants_range_def is_cap_simps descendants_inc_def del:split_paired_All)
    apply (elim exE)
    apply (rule equals0I)
    apply (drule(1) bspec)
    apply (drule spec)+
    apply (erule(1) impE)
    apply (drule(1) descendants_of_cte_at)
    apply (clarsimp simp:cte_wp_at_caps_of_state simp del:split_paired_All)
    apply (drule(1) physical_valid_cap_not_empty_range[OF caps_of_state_valid_cap,rotated])
     apply simp
    apply auto
    done
rationale: The head `is_untyped_cap` never appears in the proof body. The simp set uses `is_cap_simps` and `descendants_range_def` which may not require `is_untyped_cap cap` as a separate hypothesis if cap_range is handled by other simp rules. Trial will confirm.
strengthening_claim: (descendants_range cap p s \<and> descendants_inc (cdt s) (caps_of_state s) \<and> caps_of_state s p = Some cap \<and> valid_objs s \<and> valid_mdb s) \<Longrightarrow> (descendants_range cap p s \<and> descendants_inc (cdt s) (caps_of_state s) \<and> is_untyped_cap cap \<and> caps_of_state s p = Some cap \<and> valid_objs s \<and> valid_mdb s)
